title: The Charger's Shadow

full_text:
A traveler hired a donkey and driver to carry him across a parched desert on a blistering afternoon. Seeking relief from the scorching sun, the traveler sat down in the donkey's shadow.

The driver objected: "You hired the donkey, not his shadow! If you want the shadow, you must pay extra!"

They argued passionately, while the donkey, tired of the shouting, kicked up his heels and trotted away into the desert, leaving both men stranded under the scorching sun without donkey or shadow.
moral: Quarreling over shadows loses the real substance of the journey.
